fieldValues.title: No decision records the level or boundary where it removes choices, so technical choices reach the strategy log
fieldValues.summary: None of the 109 decisions in the srs-programme decision log links to a domain or boundary, 1 is classed boundary, and 8 are set against a principle. 14 are design-kind, among them 01cfb06e, typed per-code details for ErrorReport (srs-rust#1342): a technical choice ratified in the programme owner's session. On 2026-10-28 srs-rust#1470 asked the owner to merge a one-line ADR-011 correction.
evidence: srs-programme records/tier-2/decision-*.json, 2026-10-28: decision_kind counts policy 43, none 39, design 14, premise 5, mandate 4, preference 3, boundary 1; relations from decisions: derived-from 16, set-against 8, refines 6
fieldValues.body:
- The owner's definition (vignette 6606adfe): a decision removes future choices only at the right level; a technical ADR in a strategy context removes none, while at the technical level its impact may be huge.
- The type has no field for level or domain, and no relation from a decision to a domain or boundary is in use.
